name: prototype
description: Author and inspect prototype flows and interactions on the selected page of an explicit document. Attached desktop presentation is available when the workspace has an attached desktop.

action.description: inspect returns start frames and, with sourceId, the specified layer's interactions. set_flow and remove_flow require frameId. set_navigation requires sourceId and destinationId. remove_navigation requires sourceId. set_interactions replaces that source layer’s interactions, including triggers, transitions and ordered actions; use an empty array to clear. Navigation and overlay action dest fields use native layer IDs. preview_playback requires frameId, accepts ordered events and untilMs, and optionally renders the final frame and overlay separately. show_preview and present require frameId and an attached desktop; close_preview exits the attached preview.
